properties.name: pqs:context

Consensus-critical: replacing it is an Ethereum protocol decision, not a local code change. Hash primitive: Grover halves preimage margin only; no Shor exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Puppeth (private-network provisioning tool) reads the operator's ~/.ssh/id_rsa via ssh.ParsePrivateKey, or decrypts a passphrase-protected key via ssh.ParsePrivateKeyWithPassphrase, to authenticate deployments to remote nodes. Key material is user-supplied at runtime, not stored by this repo; the algorithms supported are whatever x/crypto/ssh parses (RSA, and others). Changeable here in that the tool could accept non-RSA keys, but the key type is the operator's choice.
